modules.name: MEC deployment preparation
modules.note: Production Nginx, systemd, environment and deployment instructions are prepared under deploy/. Actual university VM setup, DNS, trusted certificates, firewall rules and deployment acceptance remain pending. The preexisting edge ZIP contains a legacy non-loopback frontend endpoint and is preserved; build from current source using deploy/README.md.

modules.name: Real-time WebRTC network monitoring
modules.note: One-second RTCPeerConnection.getStats sampling; selected/nominated candidate-pair WebRTC RTT, jitter, packet-loss interval deltas, bitrate, FPS, resolution and connection state. Student sender-side metrics are relayed to the professor. Unit tests cover metrics and now confirm peer metrics are cleared when a participant leaves; real WebRTC/camera acceptance remains.

modules.name: Network-aware adaptive video
modules.note: High/medium/low RTCRtpSender profiles cap bitrate, frame rate and resolution scale. Policy applies smoothing, hysteresis and cooldown; RTT alone does not trigger downshift. Manual fallback selector remains available. Unit tests verify profile parameters are passed to setParameters and UI profile state advances only when a sender accepts the change; real browser encoder behavior and controlled network impairment remain untested.

modules.name: AI-assisted video analysis (optional stretch module)
modules.note: Optional FastAPI sampled-frame API and generic YOLO COCO inference adapter; authenticated Node proxy; source participant/session/frame timestamp metadata; normalized detections; object-fit-cover overlay; advisory alerts; selected detection can be cropped into the shared ROI workspace. Local AI_SERVICE_URL is configured; frontend now retries transient service errors with backoff. Model weights/dependencies are absent locally, so inference was not run. Python image tests remain unavailable because Pillow/pip are missing. Generic COCO detector only, not lab-specific or safety-critical.

modules.name: Security and authentication
modules.note: Role-bound enrollment keys; production fail-fast checks require distinct strong professor/student secrets and valid HTTPS origin/absolute data directory; bcryptjs password hashing; registered browser/device IDs; 12-hour process-memory tokens invalidated on restart; authenticated Socket.IO; session/role checks; rate limits; upload validation; append-only audit records. User/audit/session/snapshot data are persisted privately. Backend integration passed with installed bcryptjs. TLS templates use Nginx; trusted certs are not bundled. Not a security certification.

modules.name: Multi-device sessions
modules.note: Small-group star topology: one professor and up to three students, one targeted WebRTC student-to-professor connection per student, participant tiles with camera/connection state, server room isolation, per-student metrics, targeted signaling, reconnect rejoin and capacity checks. Backend tests cover three-student capacity, targeted signaling, session isolation and reconnect without ghost sockets. Real simultaneous camera acceptance on multiple browsers/devices and load measurements remain. This is not an SFU.
